# UNESCO

> UNESCO builds peace through education, science, culture, and global cooperation, advancing sustainable development and international collaboration.

UNESCO is the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization that promotes international cooperation in education, sciences, culture, and communication. The organization coordinates global initiatives including World Heritage preservation, sustainable development goals, and crisis response efforts.

## Key Topics

- Education, Science and Culture
- World Heritage
- Sustainable Development
- Peace-building
- Global Impact
- Governance Structure
- International Days and Commemorations
- General Conference
- Executive Board
- Partnerships
- Crisis Response
- Women Empowerment
- Artificial Intelligence
- World Water Development
- Director-General

## Core Organization

- [UNESCO Homepage](https://www.unesco.org/en): UNESCO homepage: Building peace through education, science, culture and global cooperation
- [UNESCO in Brief](https://www.unesco.org/en/brief): UNESCO overview: mission, vision and results in education, science and culture
- [Governance](https://www.unesco.org/en/governance): UNESCO governance structure, leadership and institutional oversight
- [Partnerships](https://www.unesco.org/en/partnerships): UNESCO partnerships with governments, private sector and NGOs for sustainable development

## News and Stories

- [Newsroom](https://www.unesco.org/en/newsroom): UNESCO newsroom with press releases, stories and multimedia updates
- [UNESCO Stories](https://www.unesco.org/en/stories): UNESCO stories featuring global impact, achievements and human-interest narratives

## Events and Meetings

- [Calendar of Events](https://www.unesco.org/en/events): UNESCO events calendar featuring activities, conferences and international observances
- [Statutory Meetings](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/statutory-meetings): UNESCO statutory meetings calendar and governance events schedule
- [Governing Bodies](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/governing-bodies): UNESCO governing bodies events: General Conference, Executive Board meetings
- [Cultural Events at Headquarters](https://www.unesco.org/en/events/cultural): Cultural events at UNESCO headquarters: exhibitions, concerts and ceremonies

## Commemorations and Observances

- [Commemorations and Celebrations](https://www.unesco.org/en/commemorations): UNESCO international commemorations and observances for global awareness
